baslik: At least 313 Palestinians killed in Israeli attacks so far: Gaza Health Ministry
metin:
The Gaza Health Ministry reported that Israeli military operations resulted in "at least 313 Palestinians" being killed, with approximately 1,990 additional Palestinians wounded in the conflict.

According to the Israeli Health Ministry, roughly 1,864 Israelis sustained injuries, including approximately 345 individuals in critical condition. Israeli Channel 12 reported at least 350 Israeli fatalities.

The Israel Defense Forces announced the names of 26 soldiers killed during border clashes, stating "Their families have been notified." Notable casualties included Col. Jonathan Steinberg (42), Lt. Col. Sahar Machluf (36), and Maj. Chen Buchris (26).

The military confirmed "We managed to regain control of most of the areas under attack. Clashes are underway in the Be'eri settlement."

Hamas initiated Operation Al-Aqsa Flood as a response to actions at the Al-Aqsa Mosque and settler violence. Israel launched Operation Swords of Iron in response.

Prime Minister Netanyahu declared "We are at war," instructing Gaza civilians to evacuate while characterizing the military response against Hamas positions.
yazar: Zeynep Hilal Karyagdi Duran, Zehra Nur Duz, Abdel Raouf Arnaout and Halime Afra Aksoy
